source: Divinity opcode help checked against Realmz newland.c direct CODE/ID consumers

domains.label: Simple Encounter choice to eliminate
domains.help: Choose one of the four choices in the currently running Simple Encounter.

domains.label: Equipment operation
domains.help: Capture the party's equipment and wealth, or restore the previously captured state.

options.label: Capture equipment
options.description: Remove and store the party's equipment and pooled wealth.

options.label: Restore equipment
options.description: Return the stored equipment and wealth to the party.

domains.label: Complex Encounter result to eliminate
domains.help: Realmz stores this as a one-based result number and clears that result in the currently running Complex Encounter.

domains.label: Camping ability
domains.help: Control whether the party may camp.

options.label: Prevent camping
options.description: The party cannot camp until another action enables it.

domains.label: Coordinate display
domains.help: Control whether Realmz shows the party's X and Y coordinates.

options.label: Show coordinates
options.description: Display the current X and Y values.

options.label: Hide coordinates
options.description: Display question marks instead of X and Y values.

domains.label: Direction to face
domains.help: Choose the party's new dungeon facing. Realmz randomizes any value outside 1 through 4.

options.label: Random direction
options.description: Choose a random facing at runtime.

domains.label: Random battles
domains.help: This affects ordinary Random Rectangle battles, not authored special random encounters.

domains.label: Allies and NPCs in battle
domains.help: Realmz treats zero as active and any nonzero value as suspended. Providence offers the canonical zero and one values.

options.label: Activate allies
options.description: Allow allied monsters and NPCs to participate.

options.label: Suspend allies
options.description: Prevent allied monsters and NPCs from participating.

numericGuidance.label: Victory points
numericGuidance.help: Enter the total victory points to share among eligible party members.

numericGuidance.label: Characters to pick
numericGuidance.help: Choose how many party members the player must select. A negative stored value restricts the picker to eligible conscious or animated characters.

numericGuidance.label: Temple price rate
numericGuidance.help: 100 means normal prices, 200 means double prices, and 50 means half prices.

signedModes.help: A negative string ID displays the message without requiring a click.
A negative shop ID enters the shop directly.
A negative sound ID pauses the script until playback completes.
The sign changes who may be selected; the magnitude remains the requested count.
A negative map ID opens the map as soon as it is awarded.
The sign chooses whether the selected quest is set or cleared.
